title: Unawareness of data processing implications
description: The child (data subject) may not fully understand how their location data will be processed, stored, or potentially shared beyond the immediate parent notification.

title: Lack of data subject control over preferences
description: The child may have limited control over how their location data is processed, stored, or shared, with insufficient mechanisms to set preferences or consent to specific processing activities.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: Processing location data beyond what is strictly necessary for the parental notification function may violate GDPR data minimization principles.
